contracts: (Missing-target invocation terminates unsuccessfully with no target identity accepted and no target-dependent operation executed.) AND (The route selector resolves the Acceptance package route through the shared capability and rejects its removal or unavailability.) AND (The route selector resolves the VDD package route through the shared capability and rejects its removal or unavailability.)
selector_intents: Remove the supported Acceptance route from route resolution and require the behavior test to fail.
Remove the supported VDD route from route resolution and require the behavior test to fail.
Run the missing-target validator case and require a failing observation if any target is accepted or inspected.
